@eng-61 Thanks for the review on ROUTEKIT-115. Re: the directed flag and closure matching: the acceptance test `test_closure_orientation` explicitly requires that `isolated_by_closures([("A","B",1),("B","C",1)], "A", [("C","B")], directed=True) == ["C"]`. A closure (C,B) must remove the road record (B,C) because they describe the same physical road — the road record's orientation is just notation. The `directed` flag controls how the adjacency is built (one-way vs two-way tra
